contexts.text: Faith and charity are now kindled in the internal man.
Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel () = indignation on the part of natural good.
His anger was kindled () = a turning away from spiritual truth.
To kindle a fire () = that which is of life from proprium. AC 10362:2.

He that kindleth the kindling, repaying he shall repay () = the restoration of the things taken away through anger from an affection of evil... The fire that goeth forth = anger from an affection of evil; hence to kindle = a taking away or consuming thereby; and that which is kindled = that which is taken away or consumed.
To kindle a fire with them for seven years () = plenary destruction through the cupidities of the loves of self and of the world.
To kindle, and to burn, = to lay waste through the cupidities of the loves of self and of the world.

That man... is kindled with good when he is reading the Word... That which is then inwardly kindled is their voluntary... If that which is then kindled in them is the genuine good of charity... it is the Voluntary of the internal man which is kindled...
To kindle a light in the lamps.
To be kindled by the fire of Heaven, is to will good.
To adorn, or kindle, the lamps = when these things come into their light.
In proportion as the love is kindled, truth shines.
To cause to ascend, or to kindle, the lamps = to illustrate with Divine truth, and thence with intelligence and wisdom.
The love... continually inflows into the understanding, and kindles it...
Hence it is customary to say, to be kindled, etc.
They are kindled with a cruel desire to injure them.
In the same proportion evil Spirits kindle him.
The will is that which is kindled with love.
In the same proportion the Lord kindles his will with the love of knowing truths.
That heavenly fire may kindle their hearts.
The mind is kindled by the mere thought of the sex. Explained.
The reason man is kindled by an attack on his love...
Hence it is that man is kindled... when his love is exalted into zeal, anger, and wrath...
It is better that the torch of the love of the sex should be first kindled with a wife.
The pieces of wood were not kindled...
When they heard that they were innocent, they were kindled...
To kindle a fire means to act what is pious.
Ho was set on fire within...
To kindle () = to consume by evils.
To kindle a fire-incendium () = the destruction of the Church by evil loves.
This is what is meant by, What will I if it is already kindled? ().
In proportion as heavenly affections inflow with the evil, the evil are kindled with the heat and cupidity to do evil and speak falsity. Explained.
The affection is the life of the thought... therefore, if the one is kindled, the other is kindled...
